intent: Prepare an invitation email for my survey participants.
actions: Start as an administrator editing the English invitation template for an active survey, with a PDF attachment configured but absent and an eligible participant with an access code and no invitation sent.
Inspect the attachment error and scroll to the configured PDF attachment with its missing-file marker.
Focus the same survey's Participants link and press Enter; wait for the participant list to load.
Open Invite & remind and choose Send email invitation; wait for the invitation preparation form to load.
